intro: The Jelly cake tin is built for bakers who love to share. With durable steel, impact resistance, and plenty of storage, it ensures every treat stays fresh, delicious, and ready to enjoy.

features.title: Ample storage for baked goods
features.text: Our tin is designed to hold cookies, cakes, and treats, giving your homemade delights a safe and stylish place to stay fresh.

features.title: Made of sturdy steel for lasting use
features.text: Our durable steel construction ensures long-term strength, protecting your baked goods while maintaining its elegant look.

features.title: Impact-resistant to handle daily use
features.text: Our design is built to withstand accidental drops and everyday handling, so your treats stay protected no matter what.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Jelly Cake Tin
